insights.title: Common policy rates transmit through different bank business models
insights.method: PESTLE economic / value chain / profit pools
insights.economic_mechanism: Deposit price/pass-through, lending duration and credit cost affect spread banks; payment fees and software royalties affect infrastructure/platform businesses differently.
insights.existing_response: Banks already manage funding, product mix and platform development.
insights.timing: Dated source periods, not inferred urgency
insights.counter_evidence: A 4% rate is not evidence that every bank margin falls; historical annual results predate the November decision.
insights.decision_boundary: Bank-specific repricing elasticity, hedges and capacity remain unproven.

insights.title: Switching and complaints illuminate different customer mechanisms
insights.method: Five Forces buyer power / customer outcomes
insights.economic_mechanism: Switches measure account movement, received complaints measure handling volume, and independent disputes measure a different escalation process.
insights.existing_response: CASS and bank complaint operations are existing capabilities.
insights.timing: Dated source periods, not inferred urgency
insights.counter_evidence: No common customer denominator or matched cohort; Q3 switch totals andQ2 bank net positions cannot be joined as same-period bank performance.
insights.decision_boundary: No measured churn cost, harmed-customer percentage or unmet remedial need established.

insights.title: Infrastructure and AI dependencies form distinct relational exposures
insights.method: PESTLE technological/legal / supplier power / relational SWOT
insights.economic_mechanism: Settlement availability, messaging standards and outsourced model/cloud dependencies sit at different layers of the operating value chain.
insights.existing_response: Existing bank collaborations, payment access and central-bank sequencing are documented.
insights.timing: Dated source periods, not inferred urgency
insights.counter_evidence: A named partner or designated provider is not proof of contract size, control failure or unallocated external scope.
insights.decision_boundary: Supplier concentration and resilience consequences require exact workload/legal-entity evidence.

insights.title: Acquisitions distort simple growth and productivity comparisons
insights.method: Industry economics / competitive positioning / value chain
insights.economic_mechanism: Acquired balances, partial-year consolidation and acquired wealth assets can raise stock measures without organic customer growth.
insights.existing_response: Acquisitions/integration programmes and member/business plans are already announced.
insights.timing: Dated source periods, not inferred urgency
insights.counter_evidence: Completed corporate choices limit strategic influence; targets are not achieved results.
insights.decision_boundary: Incremental integration choices may remain but require source-specific confirmation.

insights.title: Distinct strategic groups compete for different economic returns
insights.method: Porter rivalry / strategic groups / industry economics
insights.economic_mechanism: Mutual member value, platform licensing, infrastructure fees, ring-fenced lending and specialist cross-border credit are different profit pools.
insights.existing_response: Existing business models and capabilities explain differentiated responses.
insights.timing: Dated source periods, not inferred urgency
insights.counter_evidence: Do not aggregate Group, UK bank, USD/GBP, annual/9-month or normalised/statutory metrics into a ranking or total market value.
insights.decision_boundary: No bank-wide universal margin, TAM or available seller revenue is estimated.

political: National Payments Vision and proposed PSR/FCA consolidation: future legal state, not completed abolition (PSR-ACCESS).
economic: Rate repricing and heterogeneous funding/credit/fee economics (MPC-NOV, NBS-FY, CLEAR-RESULTS).
social: Switching choice, complaint handling, mutual member value and bank-client environmental alignment are different signals (CASS-Q3, FCA-H126, NT-RELEASE).
technological: AI/channel capabilities and separate payment/settlement dependencies (STAR-AI, NW-TECH, RTGS-FORUM).
legal: PRA legal identity and future conditional PartVII transfer differ from current Group ownership (PRA-NOV, SAN-Q3).
environmental: National Trust member resolution expresses a client governance preference; no verified bank breach or contract award (NT-RELEASE).

porter.rivalry: Incumbents, mutuals, digital, specialist and infrastructure banks have overlapping but distinct markets; no unsourced concentration share.
porter.entrants: Revolut mobilisation exit shows a regulated entry pathway; not frictionless entry or immediate mass migration (REV-UK).
porter.buyers: Switching volumes and member value show mechanisms, not a measured universal bargaining elasticity (CASS-Q3, NBS-MEMBER).
porter.suppliers: Explicit technology collaborations and settlement dependencies matter; no contract/concentration share invented (NW-TECH, STAR-CLOUD, RTGS-FORUM).
porter.substitutes: Open Banking account-to-account usage offers an alternative interaction/payment route; cumulative payments are not displaced card revenue (OB-MILESTONE).

value_chain: Funding and capital → credit origination/risk → servicing and payments → customer outcomes
Settlement/messaging, fraud controls, cloud/data and software support multiple stages; arrows are analytical functions, not bilateral contracts

profit_pools.limitation: Stock balances are not revenue or addressable supplier budget
Normalised and statutory definitions not interchangeable
Platform accounts are not UK banking customers

relational_swot.strength: Existing capital, profitable operations, technology responses and customer franchises contradict universal distress (NW-Q3, HSBC-Q3, STAR-FY).
relational_swot.weakness_hypothesis: Attribution of integration/platform net benefits can be difficult; missing disclosure is not an established control deficiency.
relational_swot.opportunity_hypothesis: Better measurement of client/product economics could aid decisions; no bank demand, scope or budget established.
relational_swot.threat: Funding competition, credit outcomes and infrastructure dependencies can affect different models; exposure and consequence require entity-specific evidence.
